related.title: Starlink LEO：傳播時間與地面路徑分離
related.titleEn: Starlink LEO: separating propagation from terrestrial path time
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 21.5 ms 與 35.8333333333 ms，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 21.5 ms and 35.8333333333 ms, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋15.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate與19.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate，建立leo_segments.csv、閘道路由版本、單向/往返對照，並完成以下驗收：18 ms單向傳播預算僅第一例可行；鏈路速率與處理延遲仍未驗證。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 15.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate and 19.3333333333 ms one-way lower estimate; create leo_segments.csv, gateway-route versions and one-way/RTT labels; apply this acceptance decision: Only the first fits an18 ms one-way propagation budget; link rate and processing delay remain unverified.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 星間路由把總距離與逐跳處理相加；hop數相同也可能有不同幾何與時間。 展開基準式 3*(2000/300000*1000+0.5)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列每hop長度與處理後累加，再以總距離/c交叉驗；記錄接入段尚未計入。 將兩條推導一起存入 iridium_hops.csv、鄰接快照、距離與處理分帳。

從原理 LEO接入只占端到端延遲的一部分；終端—衛星—閘道幾何、地面回程與排隊必須分開。 展開基準式 2*800/300000*1000+10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：按段加總並保留單向標記；不可把此數字與ping RTT直接比較或當目前Starlink服務保證。 將兩條推導一起存入 leo_segments.csv、閘道路由版本、單向/往返對照。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Inter-satellite paths sum propagation distance and per-hop processing; equal hop count does not guarantee equal geometry or delay., expand baseline expression 3*(2000/300000*1000+0.5); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum per-hop distance and processing, then cross-check total distance/c; mark ground access as excluded. Save both derivations with iridium_hops.csv, adjacency snapshot and propagation/processing ledger.

Starting from LEO access is only part of end-to-end delay; terminal/satellite/gateway geometry, terrestrial backhaul and queues need separate budgets., expand baseline expression 2*800/300000*1000+10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum labeled segments; do not compare the one-way estimate directly with ping RTT or present it as a current Starlink guarantee. Save both derivations with leo_segments.csv, gateway-route versions and one-way/RTT labels.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CCSDS TM：固定框長與校驗開銷
related.titleEn: CCSDS TM: fixed frame length and integrity overhead
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 21.5 ms 與 35.8333333333 ms，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 21.5 ms and 35.8333333333 ms, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋99.21875 percent useful bytes與96.875 percent useful bytes，建立tm_layout.csv、byte欄位示意、開銷與完整性分開報告，並完成以下驗收：題設效率至少98%時僅長框通過；須另提交受損框被拒收的測試才能驗資料完整性。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 99.21875 percent useful bytes and 96.875 percent useful bytes; create tm_layout.csv, a byte-field diagram and separate overhead/integrity reports; apply this acceptance decision: Only the longer frame meets an assumed98% efficiency target; integrity also requires evidence that corrupted frames are rejected.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 星間路由把總距離與逐跳處理相加；hop數相同也可能有不同幾何與時間。 展開基準式 3*(2000/300000*1000+0.5)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列每hop長度與處理後累加，再以總距離/c交叉驗；記錄接入段尚未計入。 將兩條推導一起存入 iridium_hops.csv、鄰接快照、距離與處理分帳。

從原理 將教學框分成標頭、資料與校驗，可分別量測開銷與錯誤偵測；吞吐效率不能證明資料正確。 展開基準式 (1024-6-2)/1024*100；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：實際建立byte索引0到長度-1，逐個標記6標頭與2尾端byte；資料計數應為1016或248。 將兩條推導一起存入 tm_layout.csv、byte欄位示意、開銷與完整性分開報告。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Inter-satellite paths sum propagation distance and per-hop processing; equal hop count does not guarantee equal geometry or delay., expand baseline expression 3*(2000/300000*1000+0.5); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum per-hop distance and processing, then cross-check total distance/c; mark ground access as excluded. Save both derivations with iridium_hops.csv, adjacency snapshot and propagation/processing ledger.

Starting from Separating a teaching frame into header, data and check fields distinguishes overhead from error detection; efficiency alone does not establish integrity., expand baseline expression (1024-6-2)/1024*100; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Build byte indices from0 to length-1 and mark6 header and2 trailing bytes; data counts must be1016 or248. Save both derivations with tm_layout.csv, a byte-field diagram and separate overhead/integrity reports.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
